crossRefs.note: I always thank my God concerning you, for the grace of God which was given you in Christ Jesus;
For who makes you different? And what do you have that you didn’t receive? But if you did receive it, why do you boast…

translations.web: I thank my God, I speak with other languages more than you all.
translations.bsb: I thank God that I speak in tongues more than all of you.
translations.kjv: I thank my God, I speak with tongues more than ye all:
translations.asv: I thank God, I speak with tongues more than you all:
